onset.Description: Intended onset of the bar-aperture frame, relative to the start of the run.

duration.Description: Intended display duration of the frame (3 Hz stimulus update rate).

trial_type.Description: Constant label; the retinotopic mapping task has no experimental conditions, only continuous bar sweeps.

stim_file.Description: Path to the displayed bar-aperture noise-pattern frame, relative to /stimuli/.

stim_dur.Description: Intended frame display duration (duplicate of duration).

run.Description: Run number, as recorded in the source data file.

fix_switch.Description: Whether the central fixation dot changed color on this frame (boolean). Detecting this color change was the participant's task during scanning.

fix_color.Description: Hex color code of the central fixation dot during this frame.

stim_onset.Description: Measured (actual, not intended) onset of the frame. Recorded for QA purposes to confirm presentation timing.

key.Description: Key pressed during this frame's response-polling window, if any. Not pre-scored against fix_switch -- see 'response'.

rt.Description: Time of the key press relative to the start of this frame's response-polling window, when a response was made. Not a reaction time relative to a fixation color change -- see 'response'.

response.Description: String label 'fix_change' if a response key was pressed during this frame's polling window, otherwise n/a (not a boolean). This is NOT pre-aligned or scored against fix_switch: each frame independently polls for any keypress during its own ~333ms window regardless of that frame's own fix_switch value. Because of normal reaction time lag relative to these frame bins, a hit on a fix_switch=True event typically produces response='fix_change' on a frame 1-2 steps later, not on the fix_switch=True row itself.
